purpose: Section 22: determine and fix whether operative-state resolution composes structural health.
gap: operative-state.ts never called the structural index's healthDiagnostics() method anywhere - a section already flagged INVALID_SOURCE_SPAN/ERROR by the structural index could still be confidently reported OPERATIVE_STATE_RESOLVED by the amendment pipeline. Reproduced by tests/foundation-audit/combined-failures.test.ts's first describe block, which previously only documented the gap via a comment.

fix.newFunction: structuralHealthForNode(index, nodeId) in amendment/operative-state.ts - checks a resolved node plus its structural descendants (a SECTION's own reported text is getNodeText(nodeId, 'DESCENDANTS'), so a corrupted descendant corrupts that text just as surely as a corrupted node itself) against healthDiagnostics()'s ERROR-severity findings only. INFO findings (AMBIGUOUS_LEGAL_REFERENCE, DUPLICATE_LABEL_EXPECTED, DUPLICATE_NORMALIZED_PATH, SECTION_NUMBER_SEQUENCE_ANOMALY) never gate anything, matching every other consumer of this API - these are normal, expected drafting realities per structural-index.ts's own header comment.
fix.compositionRule: OPERATIVE_CONFIDENCE now requires STRUCTURAL_HEALTH_SUFFICIENT in addition to a UNIQUE target-resolution match. New structuralHealthStatus/structuralHealthIssues fields added to OperativeProvisionView (types.ts). currentText is withheld and status downgraded to OPERATIVE_STATE_PARTIAL when the underlying structural interpretation is known unsafe - attemptedText stays visible (mirrors the existing targetResolutionStatus gate's own disclosed-but-withheld pattern).
fix.independenceFromTargetResolution: Deliberately independent of resolveUniqueNodeByRef/resolveUniqueDefinitionByRef's own UNIQUE/AMBIGUOUS/NOT_FOUND axis - a reference can be genuinely UNIQUE (exactly one physical occurrence carries this legal reference) while that SAME occurrence is independently known-corrupted at the structural layer. This is exactly the emergent, compound risk Architecture Invariant #18 (shared-substrate defects defeating independent-seeming systems) already names.

testUpdates: combined-failures.test.ts's first describe block updated to assert the FIXED behavior (no longer just documenting the gap via comment). 3 additional tests added: no-amendment scope unchanged, healthy-node no-regression, corrupted-descendant propagation. Also required fixing 2 pre-existing fake StructuralIndex mocks in tests/foundation-audit/effective-dating-adversarial.test.ts that lacked getDescendants/healthDiagnostics methods, since the composition now calls those on the UNIQUE-resolution path.
regressionConfirmation: semantic-coverage-real-fwrg-regression.test.ts and semantic-coverage-real-lsb-regression.test.ts (real document fixtures) produced identical discovery/compile/coverage output before and after. All CONMED/DSGR-shaped tests pass unchanged.
verdict: GENUINELY REMEDIATED - fail-closed composition now real, not merely disclosed as a gap.
